title: Rescission of a Business Enrollment: Small Business Electricity Supply Terms
content:
**Clause.** A business may rescind a Small Business Electricity Supply enrollment while the agreement is still enrollment pending. The rescission is accepted only when the business asks to rescind no later than the plan's rescission window days (3 calendar days on every plan) after the utility issued its enrollment confirmation, as shown by the utility confirmation date. Day one is the calendar day after the utility confirmation date, and the window closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the utility confirmation date plus the rescission window days. When the utility confirmation date is still empty the window has not started and a rescission is accepted. After the window, a pending enrollment can no longer be withdrawn; the business may cancel once supply starts, and the early termination fee rules apply.

## Elements of the clause

- **Status.** The agreement is enrollment pending.
- **Clock start.** The utility confirmation date recorded on the agreement, the date the utility issued its enrollment confirmation. The company's record of that date governs.
- **Counting.** Calendar days; day one is the day after the confirmation date.
- **Last accepted day.** The confirmation date plus the window days; a request made on that day is inside the window (the boundary day counts).
- **No confirmation yet.** With no utility confirmation date on record, the window has not started and a rescission is accepted.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 3-day window)

| Utility confirmation date | Date the business asks to rescind | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 7 April | 8 April (day one) | accepted |
| 7 April | 10 April (last day of the window) | accepted |
| 7 April | 11 April (the day after the window closed) | not accepted |
| empty | any date while enrollment pending | accepted |

## After the window

Once the window has closed, the pending enrollment stands. When supply has started the business may cancel the agreement, and the early termination fee rules apply to that cancellation.
